test_gateway_ensure_linger_enabled: test the gateway._ensure_linger_enabled function to auto-enable systemd linger on headless Linux installs
test_gateway_systemd_install: test the gateway.systemd_install function to install and enable the hermes-gateway systemd user service
test_gateway_get_linger_status: test the gateway.get_systemd_linger_status function to check if systemd linger is enabled for the current user
test_gateway_get_service_name: test the gateway.get_service_name function to return the hermes-gateway service name
test_gateway_get_unit_path: test the gateway.get_systemd_unit_path function to return the systemd user service unit file path
